persona: Mid-level content moderation analyst at a platform outsourcing firm
resumeText:
Farhan Qureshi | Hyderabad | farhan.q@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Trust & Safety Analyst, Lumen Review Services, Hyderabad (2021 - present)
- Reviewed user videos and comments against platform community guidelines in Hindi and English.
- Handled content moderation for hate speech, scam and nudity queues while meeting accuracy targets.
- Escalated child safety and self-harm cases to the policy team within the hour.
- Tracked weekly abuse trends in the scam queue and flagged a new fake loan app pattern.
- Prepared daily queue MIS in Google Sheets for volume, accuracy and turnaround.
- Wrote clear decision notes on appeals and shared policy gaps with the quality team.
- Used the company wellness programme and resilience breaks to manage exposure to graphic content.

Customer Support Associate, Brightline Contact Centre, Hyderabad (2019 - 2021)
- Answered chat queries for an online marketplace and logged complaints in the CRM.

EDUCATION
BA Mass Communication, Osmania University, 2019

SKILLS
Excel, SQL, Content moderation
